description: Defines the Resource interface for policy management, including methods for creating resources, retrieving properties, and JSON serialization. It also includes nested class for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: Interface representing a policy resource with methods for creation, property access, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Resource.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class defining JSON field constants for Resource, including schema version.

methods.name: Resource.newInstance
methods.description: Factory methods to create new Resource instances with different parameters.

methods.name: Resource.getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns supported JSON schema versions; only V_2.

methods.name: Resource.getEffectedPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves the EffectedPermissions object for this resource.

methods.name: Resource.toJson
methods.description: Serializes the resource to JSON, including non-hidden fields.
